name: strava
description: Browser-authenticated Strava activity media, metadata, and route tooling using Python HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Strava activity media, metadata, and routes through Python HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Strava provides browser-authenticated activity and media reads and writes, route building and creation from start location and target distance, geometry inspection, and route-quality checks using Python HTTP and a private temporary cookie file.
capabilities: Date-bounded activity discovery and visibility filtering
List, download, and verified upload of activity photos and videos
Verified activity metadata updates, including bike and start-time privacy
Route creation from start location and target distance
VT1 route scoring from BRouter GeoJSON
Strava route creation and update guidance
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Safari-authenticated Strava workflows when working with my Strava routes.
